Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE finished 1536×1024 landscape high-end Korean road-trip overview map for a mobile family itinerary. Yeosu is a peninsula extending south on far left, with Dolsando island immediately south connected by bridges. Namhae is one large distinct island centered, with smaller Changseondo immediately NORTHEAST/EAST, a strait separating it from mainland to its north. Namhae northern bridges connect to Hadong mainland, and Changseon's northeastern bridges connect to Sacheon mainland. Tongyeong is a south-extending peninsula on far right with many smaller islands to its south. Include realistic indented coastlines and soft late-autumn terrain relief. NEVER merge Namhae into mainland or put Tongyeong on the left.
Map style: clear deep blue/teal sea #0f4c75, late-autumn green and muted yellow-brown forested land, gentle mountain shadows, bright sharp refined atlas appearance. Roads are subtle neutral lines. No extraneous landmark miniatures, no invented landmark buildings.
Three travel segments, each with clear repeated small direction arrows, road-aligned across MAINLAND and actual bridge corridors, not direct sea-crossing lines:
1 solid mint #2fa596 thick route: Tongyeong at right → north/northwest into mainland Goseong/Sacheon → southwest over Changseon/Samcheonpo bridge corridor to Changseondo → main Namhae island's east coast German Village → south coast Sangju Beach → southwest Aenggang bay American Village → west-coast Sol Beach. 2 solid orange #e9782a thick route: west-coast Sol Beach → north across Noryang bridge to mainland Hadong → west through Gwangyang → cross Yi Sun-sin bridge corridor southward into Yeosu peninsula → Yeosu waterfront, cable car and Sono Calm. Do not draw straight from Namhae to Yeosu across sea.

Smaller bold dark Korean letters in white rounded pin labels: "독일마을" on Namhae east coast; "상주은모래비치" on Namhae south coast; "미국마을" on Namhae southwest bay; "쏠비치" on Namhae west coast; "해상케이블카" at southern Yeosu strait; "소노캄" on Yeosu eastern waterfront.
